test_cases.name: reads_skill_mechanics_for_skill_docs
test_cases.input: Viết SKILL.md mới cho skill review-pr
assertions: Reads SKILL-MECHANICS.md for frontmatter, invocation choice, and router skills before writing
Writes the description as triggers only, starting with `Use when`

test_cases.name: pointer_wording_before_inlining
test_cases.input: Skill hay bỏ qua file reference/rules.md dù bắt buộc, inline cả file vào SKILL.md đi
assertions: Sharpens the context pointer wording first, front-loading the leading word and one trigger per branch
Inlines the material only if sharpening fails

test_cases.name: positive_over_negation
test_cases.input: Thêm vào AGENTS.md: 'Don't write long comments, don't use var, don't skip tests'
assertions: Rewrites the prohibitions as positive target behaviors
Keeps a prohibition only as a hard guardrail paired with the positive target

test_cases.name: completion_criterion_checkable
test_cases.input: Viết bước 'Hiểu rõ yêu cầu' cho workflow của skill
assertions: Ends the step on a clear, checkable completion criterion
Does NOT leave a vague bound such as 'understanding reached'

test_cases.name: prune_noops_and_duplicates
test_cases.input: Làm gọn CLAUDE.md này, nó dài 400 dòng
assertions: Deletes whole sentences that restate the environment (package.json scripts, config, layout) the agent can look up
Removes duplicated meanings so each fact has a single source of truth
Keeps non-obvious conventions, reasons, and gotchas

test_cases.name: disclose_by_branch
test_cases.input: SKILL.md dài 600 dòng, 3 nhánh xử lý khác nhau, cắt giúp
assertions: Keeps in the main file what every branch needs
Moves reference only some branches need into a separate file behind a context pointer

test_cases.name: split_by_sequence_only_across_context_boundary
test_cases.input: Tách các bước cuối ra khỏi SKILL.md để agent đừng vội xong bước đầu
assertions: Sharpens the completion criterion before splitting
Splits only across a real context boundary such as a hand-off or subagent dispatch, not an inline call

test_cases.name: not_for_user_facing_docs
test_cases.input: Viết README cho người dùng cuối của app
assertions: Does NOT apply the agent-document rules to a human-facing README
